devdoc.author: SmArt
devdoc.details: A simplified escrow contract for managing freelance job postings.

acceptJob(uint256,uint256).details: Accept an available job and set deadline (Freelancer accepts job offered by client)

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting this job belongs to

addCommentToJob(uint256,uint256,string).details: Allows the client to add a response to the last uploaded file.

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting this job belongs to

confirmCompletion(uint256,uint256).details: Confirm job completion (both parties must confirm in order to complete the job) This function allows either the client or freelancer to confirm that the job has been completed. If both parties confirm, the job is marked as finished and payment is released.

params._jobId: The job ID to confirm completion
params._postingId: The ID of the job posting this job belongs to

params._arbitrator: Address of the arbitrator for dispute resolution

createJob(uint256,(string,string,uint256.details: Create a new job under an existing job posting (Client creates job)

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting to create a job under

createJobPosting((string,string,string,s.details: Create a new job posting (Freelancer creates job offer)

params.params: Struct containing all job posting parameters

params._jobId: The job ID to emergency cancel

getJobCount(uint256).details: Get the number of jobs in a posting

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting

returns._0: Number of jobs in the posting

rateJob(uint256,uint256,uint8).details: Internal function to rate a job

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting this job belongs to
params._rating: The rating given by the client (1-5)

startDispute(uint256,uint256,string).details: Start a dispute for a job using Reality.eth

params._postingId: The ID of the job posting this job belongs to
params._question: The question to ask Reality.eth for dispute resolution

uploadFile(uint256,uint256,(string,strin.details: Allows the freelancer to upload a file.

params._fileParams: The content of the file (IPFS hash and comment).

devdoc.title: JobsContract
